normalization_plan.reason: _to only exists to index balances and emit Transfer inside transfer, so it is merged into that function node.
_value is a transient argument fully consumed by the transfer function body.
wallet is only used as the recipient of the unsafe external ETH transfer inside buyTokens.
weiAmount is the msg.value cache used solely within buyTokens accounting.
tokens is a computed amount consumed within buyTokens before minting.
_investor is the sole beneficiary argument of buyTokens.
_weiAmount is only priced inside the validPurchaseTokens computation.
addTokens is a temporary computed inside validPurchaseTokens.
_owner selects the reserve debited and is used only by mint.
_amount is the moving quantity inside mint.
_to is the credited address inside mint.
_newOwner is written to the owner state variable only by changeOwner.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the allowance written by approve.
_from is the debited source owned solely by transferFrom.
_transfersEnabled is the value written to the transfersEnabled gate.
_spender is the allowance key incremented in increaseApproval.
_addedValue never escapes the increaseApproval arithmetic.
_subtractedValue never escapes the decreaseApproval arithmetic.
oldValue is a stack cache used only inside decreaseApproval.

numwords is the expected word count of the onlyPayloadSize assert.
operand a is bound to the SafeMath.add computation.
operand b is bound to the SafeMath.add computation.
